cards.title: Putin says US citizen Stephen Hubbard freed: Russian media

sentences.text: In addition, American envoy Steve Witkoff, who is on a visit to Russia, said, "I would like to thank you on behalf of our president, and I thank you on behalf of the U.S."Putin reportedly said that Hubbard was at Pulkovo Airport in Saint Petersburg, adding that Witkoff had thanked the Russian leader for the release.
sentences.message: summary quotes "i would like to thank you on behalf of our president, and i thank you ", which appears in none of the source articles: quote it as written or paraphrase it
